items.reason: “Wiele pająków odzyskuje” has correct singular agreement. The web-eating fact and answer remain correct.

items.reason: “Pepo” is a valid technical term, documented in Polish botanical literature. “Peponidium” is an established alternate botanical term, but its greater conventionality in Polish was not established. FAO documents “owoc dyniowaty” for cucurbit fruits; replacing the answer with it would give Polish players an obvious dynia–dyniowaty clue absent from English. No wrong answer or necessary localization correction is demonstrated. Polish textbook and FAO browser-fetch failures were resolved by direct read-only retrieval; the textbook establishes historical usage, not modern frequency.
